Sapphire Foods India Limited vs Mariyappan on 13 September, 
2024 
Author: G.R.Swaminathan
Bench: G.R.Swaminathan
 Cont. P(MD)No.2024
 Before The Madurai Bench Of Madras High Court
 Dated: 13.09.2024
 Coram:
 The Honourable Mr.Justice G.R.Swaminathan
 Cont. P(MD)No.2024 of 2024
 in
 W.P.(MD)No.16192 of 2024
 and
 Sub Aplc.(MD)No.235 of 2024
 Sapphire Foods India Limited,
 Represented by its Authorised Signatory,
 Amrit Baburao Lale,
 Having its office at
 Plot No.995J, New No.172,

 Chennai-6000040. ... Petitioner / Petitio
 Vs.
 Mariyappan
 The Designated Officer,
 Tamil Nadu Food Safety & Drug Administration Department,
 Agriculture Joint Director Campus,
 1st Floor, Collectorate Campus,
 Korampallam,
 Thoothukudi,
 Tamil Nadu-628 101 . ...  Respondent / 2nd Respondent  Prayer: Contempt Petition filed under Section 11 of the Contempt of  Courts Act, 1971, to punish the respondent for willful disobedience  1/3 Sapphire Foods India Limited vs Mariyappan on 13 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/136197799/
1 https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis  Cont. P(M  the order dated 18.07.2024 passed in W.M.P.No.14073 of 2024 in W.P.
 (MD)No.16192 of 2024.
 For Petitioner : Mr.Sathish Paraseran  Senior Counsel  for Mr.Vijayan Subraman  For Respondent : Mr.G.Thalaimutharasu  ORDER Heard the learned senior counsel appearing for the petitioner and the learned counsel appearing for the contemnor. 
2. Thiru.Mariyappan is present in person before me. He informs the Court that he will withdraw the order dated 06.09.2024 and the order dated 04.07.2024. Since the orders that were the subject matter of the contempt petition are proposed to be withdrawn, I close this contempt petition without any further remarks. The contempt petition is closed. 
Consequently, connected Sub Aplc.(MD)No.235 of 2024 is also closed.
